mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for my primary suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, look for experience specifically in home additions, especially in your local area. Verify their licensing and insurance, and check references or reviews from previous clients. A good contractor should communicate clearly, provide detailed proposals, and have a solid understanding of local building codes and permit processes. Schedule consultations with a few reputable firms to compare their approach, pricing, and project management style.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in home additions, verify their license and insurance, check references, and ensure clear communication and detailed proposals.
